newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-RECORDS TUMBLE AS N.TRANSVAAL SCORE 147.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-RECORDS TUMBLE AS N.TRANSVAAL SCORE 147.

text.p: Northern Transvaal rewrote the Currie Cup record books in a 147-8 defeat of South Western Districts at the Pietersburg Rugby Stadium on Friday night.

For the hapless men from S.W.D. it was the third successive week they had conceded a century of points. Northerns' total exceeded the 113 scored against S.W.D. by Free State two weeks ago and their 23 try total was also a new record.
Springbok left wing Jacques Olivier scored seven tries to break the previous Currie Cup record of six set 44 years ago by Boland's Buks Marais.
Flyhalf Lance Sherrell scored two tries and kicked 14 conversions for a personal tally of 38 points, level with the mark set by Natal's Henry Honiball against Boland last week.

Northern Transvaal: Tries-Jacques Olivier (7), Andre Snyman (3), Lance Sherrell (2), Joost van der Westhuizen (2), Schutte Bekker (2), Hannes Venter (2), Kobus Engelbrecht, F.A. Meiring, Louwrens Campher, Conrad Breytenbach, Willie Enslin. ConversionsLance Sherrell (14), Kobus Engelbrecht (2).
South Western Districts: Try-Paul Treu. Penalty-Jurie Coetzee.
